title: Yanomami wusinari insect beings and multitudinous dancing spirits

tellings.quote: were talking about um the Yanomami for example had these these beings which which they called the wusinari insect beings

plain: The Yanomami, an Indigenous people of the Amazon rainforest, are said to know of beings they call the wusinari, insect beings, along with many dancing spirits. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore brings this up with Michels in a conversation about DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, and he gives it as a summary without naming where it comes from. He raises it because, if such accounts match what people meet on the drug, it would suggest that different peoples have run into the same kind of beings.
